title: A Text Message
text:
Sara sends a text message to her friend Ana at six o'clock. She wants to meet at the cafe on Monday. Ana does not answer at first because she is at her dance class. After one hour, Ana reads the message and writes back.

Ana says yes, and they agree to meet at three o'clock. Sara is happy because she misses her friend. Later, Sara sends a photo of the cafe to show Ana the place. Ana sends a smiling emoji.

questions.text: What time does Sara send the message?
What time do Sara and Ana agree to meet?
How does Sara probably feel when Ana writes back?
What can we guess about Sara and Ana?
options: They do not know each other
They never talk to each other

vocabulary.definition: words that one person sends to another, often by phone
to say or write something back after someone asks or writes to you
a picture taken with a camera or a phone
feeling good because something nice has happened

paragraph_translations: Sara envía un mensaje de texto a su amiga Ana a las seis en punto. Quiere quedar en la cafetería el lunes. Ana no responde al principio porque está en su clase de baile. Después de una hora, Ana lee el mensaje y responde.

Ana dice que sí, y acuerdan verse a las tres en punto. Sara está feliz porque extraña a su amiga. Más tarde, Sara envía una foto de la cafetería para mostrarle el lugar a Ana. Ana envía un emoji sonriendo.
